prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Choose_path redesign produced the only significant win, but evidence remains thin with only one test run.
No clear effect was seen across multiple tests for adoption redesigns, choose_path copy changes, home notifications, and home wait info.
Sign-in reordering showed no clear effect in its first test and caused a significant drop in its second test.
Evidence remains thin for change kinds with only one test, including finish changes, sign-in copy, and sign-in layout.
Predictions were systematically too high in Round 1 and severely overestimated the guided companion customizer test in Round 5.
Predictions were too low for the choose_path redesign test, which was predicted to decrease performance (-0.5%) but resulted in a significant win (+6.6%).

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Split Layout Companion Path Selection: Redesign the choose_path screen into a split view comparing preset companion paths and custom pet creation paths. (why: Choose_path redesign was the only intervention that produced a significant win (+6.6%), and 21% of users bounce at this initial step.)
1: [adoption, layout] Sound Effect Audio Selector for Pets: Adds an audio preview sound component on the pick_friend screen so users can hear companion sounds before deciding. (why: Adoption has a steep drop-off (60.9% conversion) and median time of 89s; rich preview feedback increases selection confidence.)
2: [adoption, new_screen] Companion Personality Trait Selector Screen: Inserts a new screen, new_companion_traits, into the adoption flow where users customize pet behavioral traits. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pets failing or looking wrong; defining traits upfront sets clear behavior expectations.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Multi-Device Account Sync Explainer: Updates sign_in screen copy to explicitly explain how signing in preserves companion data across reinstalls and device switches. (why: The top support theme (8 emails) was users missing pets or having data reset after signing back in.)
4: [home, redesign] Card Layout Waiting Lounge with Tip Carousel: Redesigns the waiting screen with a structured card layout featuring an automated tip carousel while the pet assets render. (why: The home wait step has an extremely long mean duration (2336s / ~38 min) and leads into a 35.2% drop at the finish step.)
5: [finish, hint] Desktop Visibility Pre-Check Checklist: Adds a desktop permissions and window visibility checklist component to the home_intro screen. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on screen or the app failing to render on initial desktop launch.)
6: [finish, new_flow] Companion Controls Interactive Flow: Adds a new interactive control demo screen (new_desktop_controls_demo) right before home_intro to demonstrate how to interact, hide, and speak with the pet. (why: 3 support tickets noted post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.)
7: [adoption, wait_info] Real-Time Photo Upload Progress Monitor: Enables detailed step counting, upload progress bar, and completion notifications on the upload_photos screen. (why: Adoption custom photo rendering takes a long time (mean 1017s) and causes pet generation bugs or drop-offs.)
8: [choose_path, incentive] Playful Mascot Story Screen Greeting: Adds an animated mascot and playful welcome badge to the story screen to capture early engagement. (why: 21% of users leave at the first step; engaging welcome visuals establish positive app expectation early.)
9: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Sign-In Flow Reorder: Moves the sign_in screen after adoption_certificate in the sequence so users create an account after pet selection. (why: Sign-in early in the flow drops 27.1% of users; placing sign-in after companion adoption leverages investment bias.)
